invariants.rationale: partitionPath is used as a key into a map and must not be null based on usage.
If the map contains the partitionPath, result is the mapped value; else, result is null.
The method directly returns the value from the map for the given key.
Non-null results are empty if and only if the map maps the key to an empty list.
When result is non-null, it is always a List as returned from the map.
